brief: fresh blind judge on the W1-22 audio SAME/DIFFERENT pack B2 (32 trials, seed 22071)
role: blind judge - did NOT read the W1-22 verdict, W1-22 status files, critic-w1-22 status, any RI-AUD* item, or any game/data audio data
findings: Contention: pgrep -c headless_shell = 30, loadavg 20.28 at start and 12.35 at finish, on 4 cores. Far above the protocol cap of ~8. NO BROWSER WAS LAUNCHED - the pack already existed and was loaded, not rendered. No timing figure is reported, so no number here is contention-distorted.

GAME FINDING (biggest): zero transient onsets across all 64 recordings, 21 min 20 s of ambience - no bird, drip, gust or creak anywhere. Corroborated detector-free by crest factor, which spans only 10.0-17.4 dB (steady noise measures 10-13; one-shot events push above 20). Every region is a single unchanging hum.

GAME FINDING (positive): no two regions are indistinguishable. Globally closest pair (T22) is 4.39 dB mean apart, proxy 0.1659, still 166x further than the largest same-place re-roll. The hard stratum is by construction the 12 closest of all 78 pairs, so that is the global minimum.

GAME FINDING: 13 beds sort into four tone families by spectral centre - deep rumble (112, 133 Hz), low hum (327-588 Hz), mid-weighted (1493-1925 Hz), bright/hissy (2112-3469 Hz). Stereo correlation runs 0.001 to 0.999 with 7 of 24 clips above 0.989 i.e. effectively mono - spatial treatment is inconsistent between regions.

LEAK 1 (author missed, HIGH): reports/w1-22-critic/b2/JUDGE.md sits INSIDE the pack and states the 24 DIFFERENT / 8 SAME split, while PROMPT.md in the same directory promises 'You are not told how many of each.' The pack contradicts its own prompt. Fix: move JUDGE.md into b2.reveal/.
LEAK 2 (author missed): audio-pack-b2.mjs hardcodes hard=12, random=12, catch=8, so the class balance is recoverable from the builder source - which a judge asked to audit the builder must read.

LEAK 3 (author missed): audio-pack-b2.mjs lines 249-250 print catch-pair and hard-stratum proxy distances to stdout at build time, handing anyone who builds the pack the exact numeric SAME/DIFFERENT boundary. Should go to the reveal directory, not the terminal.

INTEGRITY DEFECT (HIGH): pack.json trials_sha256=3ab1e3b8... does not match trials.json (recomputed 14684a7c...). Cause proven: trials.json contains the literal token -23.0 sixty-four times, a form JSON.stringify cannot emit; the pretty round trip is exactly 128 bytes shorter (64 recordings x 2 chars); mapping.json is 18:29 while trials.json and pack.json are 18:31. The pack was built once then text-substituted in place rather than rebuilt. Blinding is intact but RI-MTH03 M3 auditability is broken for this pack.

LEAK CHECK PASSED: the author's loudness fix is sound and better than claimed. loudness_lufs is the constant -23.0 in all 64 recordings AND every remaining field is level-invariant by construction (crest = peak/RMS, bands relative to own loudest, centroid from normalised bands, correlation and onset rise are ratios). Verified algebraically, not assumed.

META FINDING (HIGH): the pack does not discriminate between a judge and a threshold. The tool's docstring claims it is 'stronger than a cosine threshold, because a judge decides'; a plain cosine threshold scores the same 32/32 here. B2 as instrumented measures whether the ambience emits per-region-distinct spectra (it does) and not whether a player could tell regions apart - the channel players use is events, which the pack itself shows are absent. A 1.0000 first outing should be hardened before its number is cited.

The 'seven-step unblinding order' named in the dispatch brief DOES NOT EXIST on disk - not in the pack, not in b2.reveal/ (only mapping.json), not in the builder, not in RI-MTH03. Followed JUDGE.md's three steps plus RI-MTH03 M3's hash requirement instead, and reported the discrepancy rather than back-filling.

The class-balance leak was real but INERT on this pack, and that is checkable: the pre-registered threshold sits inside a 4.6x empty gap (SAME 0.14-0.95 dB, DIFFERENT 4.39-35.76 dB), so no count information could move any trial across it. Absolute rule and count-constrained rule give the identical partition.

Blind structural inference confirmed by the reveal: clustering the 24 distinct band-vectors at cosine<0.01 recovered 13 acoustic identities, 11 at both capture seeds and 2 at one. Reveal: exactly 13 regions, 11 at both seeds, 2 at one, C(13,2)=78 pairs.

concurrency.note: Instructed not to commit and did not run git commit at any point. Another agent's blanket add-and-commit (756ffff) swept W1-22-B2-blind.md into that agent's commit between my writing the .md and the .json. Content byte-identical (git diff empty). The .json and artifacts/ remain untracked. Did not undo it - rewriting shared history would destroy a neighbour's work.

method_deviations: scratchpad/analyse.mjs - per-trial band statistics, degeneracy and float-precision leak audit, alternative-metric sensitivity check. Reads only trials.json. Archived to corpus/90-verdicts/wave1/artifacts/W1-22-B2-blind/.
scratchpad/mkanswer.mjs - emits answer.md so each trial's reason carries its real measured numbers. Reads only trials.json. Archived alongside.
Pack loaded, not rendered - it already existed and the box was at 30 browsers / loadavg 20.28.
Judge read the builder source before answering because the brief required a leak audit of it; this is the vector for LEAK 2. Declared, and shown inert by the pre-registered hashed decision rule.
notes_for_successor: The blind result is admissible and can be cited: 32/32, separation 1.0000, false_different_rate 0.0000, answers hashed before reveal. Three things a successor should act on before this number is used again. (1) Move JUDGE.md out of the pack directory into b2.reveal/ - it discloses the class balance the prompt promises to withhold. (2) Rebuild the pack rather than text-editing it, so pack.json's trials_sha256 matches its contents again. (3) Do not cite the 1.0000 as evidence that a judge can distinguish regions - a plain cosine threshold scores identically, so the pack measures the DSP front-end, not judgement. To make B2 discriminating, compare a region against itself at different times of day, or compare neighbouring regions after loudness- and spectrum-matching them. The substantive game finding to hand a builder is that region ambience has no event layer at all: 64 recordings, zero onsets, crest factor never above 17.4 dB.
